abs.title: Crunches
abs.setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat, and fingertips at your temples. Press your lower back into the mat.
abs.actionPhase: Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor, then lower with control until your shoulder blades touch again.
abs.formCheck: Keep your chin slightly tucked and your neck relaxed. Do not pull on your head or lift your hips off the mat.

bicycleCrunch.title: Bicycle Crunch
bicycleCrunch.setup: Lie on your back with your hands at your temples and your knees bent. Press your lower back into the mat.
bicycleCrunch.actionPhase: Lift your shoulders and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while the other leg reaches out. Switch sides in a steady pedal.
bicycleCrunch.formCheck: Turn from your ribs, not by yanking your neck. Keep the reaching leg long and your lower back on the mat.

battleRopes.title: Battle Ropes
battleRopes.setup: Face the anchor and hold one rope end in each hand. Sit into a wide half-squat with your chest up and your core tight.
battleRopes.actionPhase: Slam one arm up and the other down so the ropes make alternating waves all the way to the anchor. Keep the waves moving without a pause.
battleRopes.formCheck: Stay in the squat as you get tired. Make the waves with your shoulders and core, not by standing up and bouncing.

bearCrawl.title: Bear Crawl
bearCrawl.setup: Start on your hands and knees, with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. Keep your back flat.
bearCrawl.actionPhase: Brace your core and lift your knees just off the floor. Crawl forward by moving the opposite hand and foot at the same time.
bearCrawl.formCheck: Keep your hips low and your back flat like a table. Do not let your knees climb high or your hips sway side to side.

benchPress.title: Barbell Chest Press
benchPress.setup: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar. Plant your feet, pinch your shoulder blades together, and grip the bar just outside your shoulders.
benchPress.actionPhase: Lift the bar off the rack, lower it to the middle of your chest with your elbows near your sides, then press it straight up until your arms are straight.
benchPress.formCheck: Keep your hips on the bench and your wrists over your elbows. Do not bounce the bar off your chest or let your elbows flare straight out.

bicepCurls.title: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
bicepCurls.setup: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand. Pin your elbows to your sides.
bicepCurls.actionPhase: Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, turning your palms up as you reach the top. Lower them slowly back to your sides.
bicepCurls.formCheck: Keep your elbows still and your body quiet. Do not swing your hips or lean back to get the weights up.

bike.title: Indoor Bike
bike.setup: Set the saddle so your knee stays softly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke. Hold the bars and sit tall with a flat back.
bike.actionPhase: Pedal in smooth circles, pushing down through the ball of your foot and pulling up on the way back. Keep an even rhythm on both legs.
bike.formCheck: Stay seated without rocking your hips side to side. Point your knees forward and do not let them cave in.

birdDog.title: Bird Dog
birdDog.setup: Start on your hands and knees, with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. Brace your core so your back stays flat.
birdDog.actionPhase: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg straight back until both are about level with your body. Pause, then return and switch sides.
birdDog.formCheck: Keep your hips level and your reaching arm, back, and leg in one line. Do not arch your lower back or twist to lift higher.

boxJumps.title: Box Jumps
boxJumps.setup: Stand facing a box you can land on safely, with your feet about hip-width apart. Keep your knees soft and your arms ready to swing.
boxJumps.actionPhase: Dip into a quick squat, swing your arms, and jump onto the box. Land softly with both feet, stand tall, then step down.
boxJumps.formCheck: Land in a quiet squat and then stand all the way up. Do not slam your heels or jump down off a high box.

broadJumps.title: Broad Jump
broadJumps.setup: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and your arms at your sides. Hinge your hips back and bend your knees so you are ready to jump forward.
broadJumps.actionPhase: Swing your arms back, then swing them forward as you jump as far as you can. Land on both feet and sit back into the landing so you stick it.
broadJumps.formCheck: Push through both feet and land softly with your knees tracking over your toes. Do not reach so far that you fall forward on the landing.

bulgarianSplitSquat.title: Split Squat
bulgarianSplitSquat.setup: Stand in a long split with your front foot flat and your back heel lifted. Keep most of your weight on the front leg and your chest tall.
bulgarianSplitSquat.actionPhase: Bend both knees and lower straight down until your front thigh is about level and your back knee hovers near the floor. Drive through the front heel to stand.
bulgarianSplitSquat.formCheck: Keep both feet planted where they started. Do not let the front knee cave in or lean so far forward that the back leg does the work.

burpees.title: Burpees
burpees.setup: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
burpees.actionPhase: Squat down, put your hands on the floor, and jump your feet back into a plank. Jump your feet back in, then jump up and reach your arms overhead. Drop your chest to the floor on the way down if you want the full version.
burpees.formCheck: Keep your body in one straight line in the plank, and land softly. Do not let your hips sag or your back round.

calfRaises.title: Dumbbell Calf Raises
calfRaises.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet about hip-width apart. Keep a small bend in your knees and your body still.
calfRaises.actionPhase: Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can, pause, then lower your heels slowly.
calfRaises.formCheck: Move only at your ankles. Do not bounce, bend your knees more, or swing the dumbbells.

bodyweightCalfRaises.title: Calf Raises
bodyweightCalfRaises.setup: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, on the floor or with your heels hanging off a low step. Hold a wall or rail if you need balance.
bodyweightCalfRaises.actionPhase: Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can, pause, then lower your heels slowly. On a step, let the heels drop a little past flat for a stretch.
bodyweightCalfRaises.formCheck: Keep your knees soft and still. Move only at your ankles, and do not rock your body to get higher.

chestFlies.title: Chest Flies
chestFlies.setup: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand over your chest. Keep a small bend in your elbows.
chestFlies.actionPhase: Open your arms out to the sides until you feel a stretch across your chest, about in line with the bench. Sweep the weights back together over your chest and squeeze.
chestFlies.formCheck: Keep the same soft elbow bend the whole way. Do not turn it into a press, and do not drop the weights below the bench.

concentrationCurls.title: Concentration Curls
concentrationCurls.setup: Sit on a bench and lean forward so your working arm hangs inside your thigh. Brace the back of that upper arm against the inside of your leg.
concentrationCurls.actionPhase: Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, squeeze, then lower it until your arm is almost straight.
concentrationCurls.formCheck: Keep your upper arm glued to your thigh. Do not swing the weight or lift your elbow off your leg.

deadBug.title: Dead Bug
deadBug.setup: Lie on your back with your arms reaching toward the ceiling and your knees bent over your hips. Press your lower back flat into the floor.
deadBug.actionPhase: Reach one arm overhead and stretch the opposite leg forward, both hovering just off the floor. Bring them back, then switch sides.
deadBug.formCheck: Keep your lower back pressed down the whole time. If it lifts, shorten the reach instead of forcing a longer one.

dips.title: Dips
dips.setup: Grip the parallel bars and hold yourself up with your arms straight. Bend your knees and cross your ankles behind you so your feet stay clear.
dips.actionPhase: Lean your chest slightly forward and bend your elbows to lower until your upper arms are about level. Press back up until your arms are straight.
dips.formCheck: Keep your elbows close and your shoulders down. Do not drop so low that your shoulders roll forward or shrug up by your ears.

dumbbellChestPress.title: Dumbbell Chest Press
dumbbellChestPress.setup: Lie on a bench with your feet flat and a dumbbell in each hand over your chest. Pinch your shoulder blades into the pad.
dumbbellChestPress.actionPhase: Lower the dumbbells toward the outsides of your chest with your elbows near your sides, then press them straight up until your arms are straight.
dumbbellChestPress.formCheck: Keep your wrists over your elbows and your hips on the bench. Do not bounce the weights or let your elbows flare straight out.

dumbbellLunges.title: Dumbbell Lunges
dumbbellLunges.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging by your sides, and your feet about hip-width apart.
dumbbellLunges.actionPhase: Step forward or back into a long stride and lower until your front thigh is about level and your back knee hovers near the floor. Push through the front heel to stand, then switch legs.
dumbbellLunges.formCheck: Keep your torso tall and the dumbbells still. Do not let the front knee cave in or the weights swing you off balance.

dumbbellRow.title: Dumbbell Row
dumbbellRow.setup: Put one knee and the same-side hand on a bench so your back is flat and about level with the floor. Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with that arm hanging straight.
dumbbellRow.actionPhase: Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, leading with your elbow, until it reaches your lower ribs. Lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
dumbbellRow.formCheck: Keep your back flat and your hips still. Do not twist your body or shrug your shoulder to finish the pull.

dumbbellShoulderPress.title: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
dumbbellShoulderPress.setup: Sit tall against a bench with your feet flat and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
dumbbellShoulderPress.actionPhase: Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are straight overhead, then lower them until your elbows are about level with your shoulders.
dumbbellShoulderPress.formCheck: Keep your ribs down and your back on the pad. Do not lean back or shrug your shoulders up to finish the press.

farmerCarry.title: Farmer's Carry
farmerCarry.setup: Stand between two heavy weights, hinge down with a flat back, and lift them to your sides. Stand tall with your shoulders down and your core tight.
farmerCarry.actionPhase: Walk forward in short, steady steps. Keep the weights still and your body tall until the carry is done, then set them down the same way you picked them up.
farmerCarry.formCheck: Do not let the weights pull you into a slouch or a lean to one side. Keep your shoulders packed down and your steps quiet.

footballBallMastery.title: Ball Mastery
footballBallMastery.setup: Stand over the ball with your knees softly bent and your chest leaning slightly forward. Keep your arms out a little for balance.
footballBallMastery.actionPhase: Tap the top of the ball lightly with the sole of one foot, then the other, in a steady rhythm. Stay on the balls of your feet as you switch.
footballBallMastery.formCheck: Keep the touches soft and the ball close. Stay low, and do not stand up straight or kick the ball away.

footballConeSlalom.title: Cone Slalom
footballConeSlalom.setup: Start a step away from the first cone with your knees bent and your weight ready to shift. Keep the ball close to your feet.
footballConeSlalom.actionPhase: Cut around each cone by pushing off the inside of your back foot and guiding the ball with the inside or outside of the front foot. Lean into the turn, then accelerate to the next cone.
footballConeSlalom.formCheck: Stay low and take the ball with you through the turn. Do not stand tall or leave the ball behind the cone.

footballControl.title: Ball Control
footballControl.setup: Get ready to receive with your knees bent and your weight on one foot. Open your hips toward the ball so you can cushion it.
footballControl.actionPhase: Meet the ball with the inside of your foot or the middle of your thigh, and give a little as it arrives so it drops in front of you. Set it, then play your next touch.
footballControl.formCheck: Lean back slightly to take the pace off the ball. Do not stab at it with a stiff leg or let it bounce away.

footballDribbling.title: Outside Laces
footballDribbling.setup: Start in a low dribbling stance with the ball just ahead of your front foot and your knees bent. Keep one arm out a little to protect the ball.
footballDribbling.actionPhase: Push the ball forward with the outside of your foot, using the area around the laces. Push off your back foot and take your next touch before the ball gets away.
footballDribbling.formCheck: Stay over the ball and keep each touch small. Do not toe-poke it or stand up as you speed up.

footballElastico.title: Elastico
footballElastico.setup: Face a cone or an imaginary defender with your knees bent and the ball just outside your front foot.
footballElastico.actionPhase: Push the ball outward with the outside of that foot, then quickly hook it back inside with the inside of the same foot before you accelerate past.
footballElastico.formCheck: Stay low and keep the touch small. Do both moves with the same foot, without stopping to reset.

footballFootwork.title: Footwork
footballFootwork.setup: Stand over the ball on the balls of your feet, knees bent, with your chest slightly forward. Balance on one foot so the other is free to touch the ball.
footballFootwork.actionPhase: Tap the ball inward with the inside of your free foot, then switch feet and tap it back the other way. Keep a light, even rhythm.
footballFootwork.formCheck: Stay on the ball of your standing foot and keep the ball under you. Do not plant your heel or take big, heavy touches.

footballHeadStall.title: Head Stall
footballHeadStall.setup: Stand with your knees soft and your hips slightly back. Tip your chest and chin up so your forehead is the flat spot the ball can sit on.
footballHeadStall.actionPhase: Let the ball settle on the center of your forehead and hold it still. Use small shifts of your feet and arms to keep your balance.
footballHeadStall.formCheck: Look up at the ball and keep your neck long, not jammed. If the ball rolls off, reset it instead of chasing it with your head.

footballReactionDrills.title: Reaction Drills
footballReactionDrills.setup: Start in a wide, low stance with your knees bent and your weight on the balls of your feet. Keep your eyes up so you can react.
footballReactionDrills.actionPhase: On the cue, plant one foot wide to stop, shift your weight, and push off toward the new direction. Turn your chest with the move and get your feet set again.
footballReactionDrills.formCheck: Stay low when you brake and use your arms for balance. Do not stand up tall or cross your feet before you change direction.

footballWallPassing.title: Wall Passing
footballWallPassing.setup: Stand about two steps from a wall or rebounder, with the ball beside your standing foot. Point your hips toward the wall.
footballWallPassing.actionPhase: Pass with the inside of your foot so the ball hits the wall and comes back. Cushion the return with the inside of your foot, then pass again.
footballWallPassing.formCheck: Keep the pass along the ground and your standing foot planted. Do not toe-poke the ball or stand so close that you have no time to control it.

frontRaises.title: Front Raise
frontRaises.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your legs. Keep a tiny bend in your elbows.
frontRaises.actionPhase: Raise the dumbbells forward until your hands are about shoulder height, then lower them slowly back to your thighs.
frontRaises.formCheck: Keep your body still and lift with your shoulders. Do not swing the weights or lean back to help them up.

gluteBridge.title: Glute Bridge
gluteBridge.setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and about hip-width apart, and your arms by your sides.
gluteBridge.actionPhase: Push through your heels and lift your hips until your body makes a straight line from shoulders to knees. Squeeze, then lower your hips with control.
gluteBridge.formCheck: Finish by squeezing your glutes, not by arching your lower back. Keep your ribs down and your chin slightly tucked.

gluteKickbacks.title: Glute Kickbacks
gluteKickbacks.setup: Start on your hands and knees, with your shoulders over your wrists and your hips over your knees. Keep your back flat.
gluteKickbacks.actionPhase: Kick one leg back and up until your thigh is about level with your body, squeeze your glute, then lower the knee toward the floor.
gluteKickbacks.formCheck: Keep your hips square and your ribs down. Do not arch your lower back just to lift the leg higher.

hammerCurls.title: Hammer Curls
hammerCurls.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other and thumbs pointing forward. Pin your elbows to your sides.
hammerCurls.actionPhase: Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists, then lower them slowly.
hammerCurls.formCheck: Keep your elbows still beside your ribs. Do not swing your shoulders or let the weights drift forward.

hangingKneeRaises.title: Knee Raises
hangingKneeRaises.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar, or brace your forearms in a captain's chair, with your legs hanging straight. Keep your shoulders down.
hangingKneeRaises.actionPhase: Draw both knees up until your thighs pass level with your hips, then lower your legs slowly without swinging.
hangingKneeRaises.formCheck: Start the lift from your abs and keep your body still. Do not kip or swing your legs to get your knees up.

highKnees.title: High Knees
highKnees.setup: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your core tight. Stay on the balls of your feet.
highKnees.actionPhase: Drive one knee up until your thigh is about level, then switch legs in a quick running rhythm. Pump your arms with the steps.
highKnees.formCheck: Stay tall and land softly. Do not lean back or let your feet slap flat on the floor.

hollowHold.title: Hollow Hold
hollowHold.setup: Lie on your back with your legs together and your arms reaching overhead. Press your lower back into the floor.
hollowHold.actionPhase: Lift your shoulders and legs a little off the floor and hold that shape. Keep your arms and legs long.
hollowHold.formCheck: If your lower back lifts off the floor, raise your legs or lower your arms until your back stays flat. Do not hold your breath.

inchworm.title: Inchworm
inchworm.setup: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your core tight.
inchworm.actionPhase: Hinge down and put your hands on the floor, then walk them forward until you are in a long plank. Walk your hands back to your feet and stand up.
inchworm.formCheck: Keep your legs as straight as you can and your hips from sagging in the plank. Look at the floor so your neck stays in line.

inclineBench.title: Dumbbell Incline Chest Press
inclineBench.setup: Sit on a bench set on a moderate incline, feet planted, with a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders. Pinch your shoulder blades into the pad.
inclineBench.actionPhase: Press the dumbbells up over your upper chest until your arms are straight, then lower them until your elbows are about level with the bench.
inclineBench.formCheck: Keep your wrists over your elbows and your back on the pad. Do not bounce the weights or flare your elbows straight out.

inclineFlies.title: Incline Fly
inclineFlies.setup: Lie on a moderate incline with a dumbbell in each hand over your upper chest and a small bend in your elbows. Plant your feet.
inclineFlies.actionPhase: Open your arms out to the sides until you feel a stretch in your upper chest, then sweep the weights back together and squeeze.
inclineFlies.formCheck: Keep the same soft elbow bend the whole way. Do not drop the weights toward your stomach or turn the move into a press.

jumpRope.title: Jump Rope
jumpRope.setup: Stand tall with the rope behind your heels and your elbows close to your sides. Hold the handles so your wrists can turn the rope.
jumpRope.actionPhase: Turn the rope with your wrists and make small hops on the balls of your feet so the rope passes under you. Keep a steady rhythm.
jumpRope.formCheck: Jump just high enough to clear the rope. Do not donkey-kick your heels or stomp down on flat feet.

jumpingJacks.title: Jumping Jacks
jumpingJacks.setup: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
jumpingJacks.actionPhase: Jump your feet out wide as you raise your arms overhead, then jump back to the start. Land softly and keep the rhythm even.
jumpingJacks.formCheck: Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees soft. Do not slam your heels or let your knees cave in as you land.

jumpingLunges.title: Jump Lunges
jumpingLunges.setup: Start in a lunge with your front thigh about level, your back knee near the floor, and your torso tall.
jumpingLunges.actionPhase: Jump up, switch your legs in the air, and land softly in a lunge on the other side. Sink into the landing, then jump again.
jumpingLunges.formCheck: Land with your front knee over your toes, not caving in. Keep your torso tall and do not crash the back knee into the floor.

kettlebellCleanPress.title: Kettlebell Clean and Press
kettlebellCleanPress.setup: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor between them. Hinge down and grip the handle with one hand.
kettlebellCleanPress.actionPhase: Hike the bell back a little, snap your hips, and pull it up so it lands in the rack at your shoulder with your elbow in. Then press it overhead until your arm is straight, and lower it back to the rack.
kettlebellCleanPress.formCheck: Keep the bell close to your body and your wrist straight in the rack. Do not lean back or let your elbow flare out on the press.

kettlebellDeadlift.title: Kettlebell Deadlift
kettlebellDeadlift.setup: Stand over the kettlebell so the handle lines up with the middle of your feet. Hinge your hips back, bend your knees a little, and grip the handle with a flat back.
kettlebellDeadlift.actionPhase: Push the floor away and stand up tall, squeezing your glutes at the top. Hinge the bell back down the same way until it settles between your feet.
kettlebellDeadlift.formCheck: Keep your back flat from your head to your hips. Do not round your lower back or yank the bell up with your arms.

kettlebellGobletSquat.title: Goblet Squat
kettlebellGobletSquat.setup: Hold the kettlebell at your chest by the horns, with your elbows pointing down. Set your feet about shoulder-width apart and turn your toes out a little.
kettlebellGobletSquat.actionPhase: Sit your hips down between your heels until your hips drop to about knee height, then drive through your feet to stand.
kettlebellGobletSquat.formCheck: Keep your chest up, your heels down, and your knees tracking over your toes. Do not let the bell pull you forward.

kettlebellGorillaRow.title: Gorilla Row
kettlebellGorillaRow.setup: Set two kettlebells on the floor and stand over them in a wide stance. Hinge forward until your back is flat and both hands can reach the handles.
kettlebellGorillaRow.actionPhase: Brace one hand on its bell, then row the other bell up toward your ribs. Lower it, then row the other side.
kettlebellGorillaRow.formCheck: Keep your hips and chest square to the floor. Do not twist or rock from side to side as you switch arms.

kettlebellHalo.title: Kettlebell Halo
kettlebellHalo.setup: Stand tall and hold the kettlebell upside down by the horns at your chest. Keep your ribs down and your feet about hip-width apart.
kettlebellHalo.actionPhase: Circle the bell slowly around your head, passing it behind your neck, then bring it back to your chest. Reverse the direction on the next rep.
kettlebellHalo.formCheck: Keep your head still and move from your shoulders. Do not duck your chin or twist your lower back to make the circle.

kettlebellRow.title: Kettlebell Row
kettlebellRow.setup: Put one knee and the same-side hand on a bench so your back is flat. Hold the kettlebell in the free hand with that arm hanging straight.
kettlebellRow.actionPhase: Pull the bell up toward your hip, leading with your elbow, until it reaches your lower ribs. Lower it until your arm is straight.
kettlebellRow.formCheck: Keep your back flat and your hips still. Do not twist your body or shrug your shoulder to finish the pull.

kettlebellSnatch.title: Kettlebell Snatch
kettlebellSnatch.setup: Stand over the bell with a wide stance, hinge back, and grip the handle with one hand. Let that arm stay loose.
kettlebellSnatch.actionPhase: Hike the bell back between your legs, snap your hips, and let it swing up. As it reaches chest height, pull your elbow back and punch your hand up so the bell settles on the back of your forearm overhead.
kettlebellSnatch.formCheck: Keep the bell close and catch it softly on your forearm. Stand tall at the top without arching your lower back.

kettlebellSwings.title: Kettlebell Swing
kettlebellSwings.setup: Set your feet a little wider than your shoulders, with the bell on the floor a short step in front of you. Hinge at your hips, grab the handle with both hands, and hike the bell back between your legs.
kettlebellSwings.actionPhase: Snap your hips forward and let the bell float up to about chest height. As it comes back down, hinge again and guide it between your legs.
kettlebellSwings.formCheck: Drive with your hips, not by squatting or lifting with your arms. Stand tall at the top without leaning back.

kettlebellTurkishGetUp.title: Turkish Get-Up
kettlebellTurkishGetUp.setup: Lie on your back holding a light kettlebell straight up in one hand, and bend the knee on that same side. Keep your eyes on the bell.
kettlebellTurkishGetUp.actionPhase: Roll onto your free elbow, then your hand. Sweep the straight leg back into a kneel, then stand up, keeping the bell locked overhead the whole way. Reverse the steps to lie back down.
kettlebellTurkishGetUp.formCheck: Move slowly and keep the bell stacked over your shoulder. If your arm bends or you lose sight of the bell, go back a step.

lateralRaises.title: Lateral Raises
lateralRaises.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and your palms facing in. Keep a small bend in your elbows.
lateralRaises.actionPhase: Raise both arms out to the sides until your hands are about shoulder height, then lower them slowly.
lateralRaises.formCheck: Lead with your elbows and keep your body still. Do not swing the weights or shrug your shoulders up to your ears.

lunges.title: Lunges
lunges.setup: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your hands at your hips or your chest.
lunges.actionPhase: Step forward into a long stride and lower until your front thigh is about level and your back knee hovers near the floor. Push through the front heel to stand, then switch legs.
lunges.formCheck: Keep your torso tall and your front knee over your toes. Do not let that knee cave in or rush the step.

medBallSlams.title: Ball Slams
medBallSlams.setup: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders and hold a medicine ball that can bounce at your hips.
medBallSlams.actionPhase: Reach the ball overhead as you rise onto your toes, then slam it straight down in front of you. Catch the bounce, or pick it up, and go again.
medBallSlams.formCheck: Use your core to throw the ball down, and hinge your hips back as it hits so you stay balanced. Do not round your back or throw the ball behind you.

mountainClimbers.title: Mountain Climbers
mountainClimbers.setup: Start in a straight-arm plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in one line. Look at the floor.
mountainClimbers.actionPhase: Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs in a steady running rhythm. Keep your hands planted.
mountainClimbers.formCheck: Keep your hips level and your shoulders over your hands. Do not bounce your hips up or let your lower back sag.

overheadTricepExtension.title: Triceps Extension
overheadTricepExtension.setup: Stand tall and hold one weight overhead with both hands, arms straight and close to your ears.
overheadTricepExtension.actionPhase: Bend only your elbows to lower the weight behind your head, then straighten your arms to press it back up.
overheadTricepExtension.formCheck: Keep your upper arms still and your ribs down. Do not flare your elbows wide or arch your lower back.

tricepKickbacks.title: Triceps Kickback
tricepKickbacks.setup: Hinge at your hips with one hand and the same-side knee on a bench, and plant your free foot. Pin your working upper arm to your side with the elbow bent.
tricepKickbacks.actionPhase: Keep that upper arm still and straighten your elbow until your forearm points back behind you. Bend the elbow to return.
tricepKickbacks.formCheck: Move only at the elbow. Do not swing your upper arm or shrug your shoulder to lift the weight.

plank.title: Plank
plank.setup: Rest on your forearms and toes, with your elbows under your shoulders and your hands flat on the floor.
plank.actionPhase: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your body holds a straight line from head to heels. Breathe and hold.
plank.formCheck: Look at the floor so your neck stays in line. Do not let your lower back sag or your hips hike up.

plateRotations.title: Plate Rotations
plateRotations.setup: Stand with a wide stance and hold a plate straight out in front of your chest with both hands. Keep your arms mostly straight and your ribs down.
plateRotations.actionPhase: Turn the plate like a steering wheel, about a quarter turn to each side, then return to the center. Keep your arms at chest height.
plateRotations.formCheck: Keep your hips and legs still and let your core resist the turn. Do not drop the plate or twist from your lower back.

pullUps.title: Pull-Ups
pullUps.setup: Hang from a bar with your hands just outside your shoulders and your palms facing away. Let your shoulders settle down, away from your ears.
pullUps.actionPhase: Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it, driving your elbows down and back. Lower yourself until your arms are almost straight.
pullUps.formCheck: Start each rep from a still hang. Do not kip, swing your legs, or shrug your shoulders up to your ears.

pullover.title: Dumbbell Pullover
pullover.setup: Lie across a bench so only your upper back and shoulders are supported, and plant your feet. Hold one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
pullover.actionPhase: Keep a small bend in your elbows and lower the dumbbell in an arc until it is just past your head. Pull it back over your chest.
pullover.formCheck: Keep that elbow bend the same the whole way. Do not turn it into a triceps extension or let your lower back over-arch off the bench.

pushups.title: Push-Up
pushups.setup: Start in a high plank with your hands a little wider than your shoulders, fingers spread, and your feet together. Brace your core so your body is one line.
pushups.actionPhase: Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows near your sides. Press the floor away until your arms are straight.
pushups.formCheck: Keep your hips in line with your shoulders. Look at the floor between your hands, and do not let your lower back sag.

renegadeRow.title: Renegade Row
renegadeRow.setup: Hold a plank on two dumbbells with your hands under your shoulders and your feet set wider than your hips. Keep your body in one line.
renegadeRow.actionPhase: Press one dumbbell into the floor and row the other up toward your ribs, then lower it. Switch sides.
renegadeRow.formCheck: Keep your hips square to the floor. Do not twist or hike one hip as you row.

reverseFly.title: Reverse Flies
reverseFly.setup: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and hinge forward until your back is flat and the dumbbells hang under your shoulders. Keep a small bend in your elbows.
reverseFly.actionPhase: Raise your arms out to the sides until they are about level with your back, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower the weights slowly.
reverseFly.formCheck: Keep your back angle still and lift from your upper back. Do not stand up or swing the weights to finish the rep.

rowing.title: Rowing Machine
rowing.setup: Sit on the rower, strap your feet in, and hold the handle with your arms straight. Slide forward so your shins are about vertical and your back is flat.
rowing.actionPhase: Push with your legs first, then lean back a little, then pull the handle to your lower ribs. Return in reverse: arms, then body, then legs.
rowing.formCheck: Keep that order on every stroke. Do not pull with your arms before your legs finish, or round your back at the catch.

russianTwists.title: Russian Twists
russianTwists.setup: Sit with your knees bent and lean your chest back until your core is working. Lift your feet if you can balance, and hold your hands together at your chest.
russianTwists.actionPhase: Turn your ribs from side to side, tapping your hands near each hip. Keep the lean the same as you rotate.
russianTwists.formCheck: Turn from your ribs, not just your arms. Keep your knees quiet, and do not round your back or use momentum.

shadowBoxing.title: Shadow Boxing
shadowBoxing.setup: Stand in a staggered stance with your knees soft, your back heel light, and both hands guarding your cheeks.
shadowBoxing.actionPhase: Throw jabs, crosses, and hooks, and slip your head off the center line between punches. Shift your weight and turn your hips with each punch, then bring the hand home.
shadowBoxing.formCheck: Keep the hand that is not punching up by your face. Exhale on each punch, and do not drop your guard or lean back.

sidePlank.title: Side Plank
sidePlank.setup: Lie on your side, propped on your forearm with your elbow under your shoulder. Stack your feet and your hips.
sidePlank.actionPhase: Lift your hips until your body makes a straight line from your head to your heels. Hold, and breathe.
sidePlank.formCheck: Keep your hips up and your chest facing the side, not the floor. Do not let the bottom hip sag or your shoulder shrug into your ear.

skaterHops.title: Skater Hops
skaterHops.setup: Stand on one foot in a small squat, with your chest leaning slightly forward and the other leg ready to swing behind you.
skaterHops.actionPhase: Hop sideways onto the other foot, land softly, and let the back leg sweep behind you. Pause just long enough to balance, then hop back.
skaterHops.formCheck: Land on the middle of your foot and keep the knee over the toes. Do not let the knee cave in or land stiff-legged.

sledPush.title: Sled Push
sledPush.setup: Grip the sled poles with your arms straight and lean your body forward so your back stays flat. Set one foot behind you, ready to drive.
sledPush.actionPhase: Push the floor away with short, powerful steps, driving through the ball of each foot. Keep your arms long and the sled moving.
sledPush.formCheck: Stay in the lean and push with your legs. Do not stand up tall or bend your arms and pull with your back.

squatJumps.title: Squat Jumps
squatJumps.setup: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.
squatJumps.actionPhase: Sit into a partial squat, swing your arms, and jump straight up. Land softly on both feet and sink back into the next squat.
squatJumps.formCheck: Land with your knees tracking over your toes and your chest up. Do not land stiff or let your knees cave in.

squats.title: Squats
squats.setup: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your toes turned out a little. Brace your core and keep your chest up.
squats.actionPhase: Sit your hips down and back until your hips are about as low as your knees, then drive through your feet to stand tall.
squats.formCheck: Keep your heels down and your knees tracking over your toes. Do not let your knees cave in or your lower back round at the bottom.

stepUps.title: Step-Ups
stepUps.setup: Stand facing a box or bench and place one whole foot on top of it. Keep your chest tall.
stepUps.actionPhase: Drive through the heel on the box to stand up, and let the other foot come up without pushing off the floor. Step back down with control and switch legs.
stepUps.formCheck: The foot on the box does the work. Do not push off the floor with your back toes or let the front knee cave in.

bodyweightSumoSquats.title: Sumo Squats
bodyweightSumoSquats.setup: Take a wide stance with your toes turned out and your hands together at your chest. Keep your chest up.
bodyweightSumoSquats.actionPhase: Sit your hips straight down until your thighs are about level, with your knees tracking over your toes. Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your inner thighs.
bodyweightSumoSquats.formCheck: Keep your knees out over your toes and your heels down. Do not let your knees collapse in or your chest fall forward.

sumoSquats.title: Kettlebell Sumo Squats
sumoSquats.setup: Take a wide stance with your toes turned out and hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands. Keep your elbows down.
sumoSquats.actionPhase: Sit your hips straight down until your thighs are about level, keeping the bell close to your chest. Drive through your heels to stand.
sumoSquats.formCheck: Keep your knees over your toes and your chest up. Do not let the bell pull you forward or your knees cave in.

thrusters.title: Thrusters
thrusters.setup: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold the weights at your shoulders, elbows forward.
thrusters.actionPhase: Squat down until your hips are about as low as your knees, then drive up and use that momentum to press the weights overhead. Lower the weights to your shoulders as you sit into the next squat.
thrusters.formCheck: Keep your chest tall in the squat and press only as your legs finish standing. Do not press early or let your knees cave in.

tuckJumps.title: Tuck Jumps
tuckJumps.setup: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and arms ready to swing.
tuckJumps.actionPhase: Dip into a small squat and jump up, pulling both knees toward your chest. Land softly on the middle of your feet and sink into the next dip.
tuckJumps.formCheck: Pull your knees up, then get your feet back under you before you land. Do not land stiff or with your knees locked.

wallBalls.title: Wall Balls
wallBalls.setup: Face a wall and hold a medicine ball at your chest, with your feet about shoulder-width apart. Stand far enough back that the ball can travel up to the target.
wallBalls.actionPhase: Squat down, then drive up and throw the ball to the target in the same motion. Catch it, bring it back to your chest, and sit into the next squat.
wallBalls.formCheck: Use your legs to throw, and catch the ball with soft hands. Do not pause at the bottom or throw with your arms alone.

arnoldPress.title: Seated Arnold Press
arnoldPress.setup: Sit tall on a bench with your feet flat and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing you.
arnoldPress.actionPhase: Press the weights up and turn your palms forward so they face away from you at the top. Reverse the turn as you lower them to your shoulders.
arnoldPress.formCheck: Keep your ribs down and your back on the bench. Turn the weights smoothly, and do not shrug your shoulders to finish.

standingArnoldPress.title: Dumbbell Arnold Press
standingArnoldPress.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing you, and your ribs down.
standingArnoldPress.actionPhase: Press the weights up and turn your palms forward so they face away from you at the top. Reverse the turn as you lower them to your shoulders.
standingArnoldPress.formCheck: Keep your glutes tight so you do not lean back. Turn the weights smoothly, and do not shrug your shoulders to finish.

declineBench.title: Decline Bench Press
declineBench.setup: Lie on a decline bench with your feet locked in and your eyes under the bar. Pinch your shoulder blades into the pad and grip the bar just outside your shoulders.
declineBench.actionPhase: Lift the bar off the rack, lower it to your lower chest with your elbows near your sides, then press it up until your arms are straight.
declineBench.formCheck: Keep your hips on the pad and your wrists over your elbows. Do not bounce the bar off your chest or let your elbows flare straight out.

legPress.title: Leg Press
legPress.setup: Sit in the leg press with your lower back and hips flat on the pad. Place your feet about shoulder-width apart on the platform.
legPress.actionPhase: Unlock the sled and bend your knees until your thighs are near the pad, then press through the middle of your feet until your legs are almost straight.
legPress.formCheck: Keep your lower back on the pad the whole way. Do not lock your knees hard or let them cave in.

legExtension.title: Leg Extension
legExtension.setup: Sit tall with your back against the pad and the roller on your lower shins. Hold the handles so your hips stay down.
legExtension.actionPhase: Straighten both knees until your legs are straight, pause, then lower the weight slowly.
legExtension.formCheck: Move only at your knees. Do not swing the weight or lift your hips off the seat.

legCurl.title: Leg Curl
legCurl.setup: Lie or sit in the curl machine with the pad just above your heels and your hips held in place.
legCurl.actionPhase: Curl your heels toward your glutes as far as you can, pause, then lower the weight slowly.
legCurl.formCheck: Keep your hips down and still. Do not yank with your lower back to finish the curl.

hackSquat.title: Hack Squat
hackSquat.setup: Stand on the platform with your back and shoulders against the pads and your feet about shoulder-width apart, slightly forward.
hackSquat.actionPhase: Unlock the sled and lower until your thighs are about level, then drive through the middle of your feet to stand.
hackSquat.formCheck: Keep your heels down and your knees over your toes. Do not bounce out of the bottom or let your lower back peel off the pad.

smithMachineSquat.title: Smith Machine Squat
smithMachineSquat.setup: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with your feet slightly in front of the bar so you can sit down. Brace your core.
smithMachineSquat.actionPhase: Unrack the bar and squat until your hips are about as low as your knees, then stand by driving through the middle of your feet.
smithMachineSquat.formCheck: Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes. Do not let your knees cave in or your heels lift.

calfRaiseMachine.title: Machine Calf Raise
calfRaiseMachine.setup: Place the balls of your feet on the platform with your heels hanging free, and set the pads on your shoulders or thighs.
calfRaiseMachine.actionPhase: Let your heels drop for a stretch, then rise onto your toes and squeeze at the top. Lower slowly.
calfRaiseMachine.formCheck: Use the full stretch and the full squeeze. Do not bounce, and keep your knees pointing forward.

hipAbductor.title: Hip Abductor
hipAbductor.setup: Sit tall with the pads on the outsides of your knees or thighs and your back against the pad.
hipAbductor.actionPhase: Push your legs apart against the pads, pause, then bring them back together slowly.
hipAbductor.formCheck: Keep your lower back on the pad and move from your hips. Do not lean your body to help the pads move.

hipAdductor.title: Hip Adductor
hipAdductor.setup: Sit tall with the pads on the insides of your knees or thighs and your back against the pad.
hipAdductor.actionPhase: Squeeze your legs together, pause, then let the pads open slowly.
hipAdductor.formCheck: Keep your hips planted and the squeeze smooth. Do not yank with your torso or bounce at the end.

hipThrustMachine.title: Machine Hip Thrust
hipThrustMachine.setup: Sit with your upper back against the pad, your feet flat, and the belt or pad across your hips.
hipThrustMachine.actionPhase: Drive through your heels until your body makes a straight line from shoulders to knees, then lower with control.
hipThrustMachine.formCheck: Finish by squeezing your glutes, not by arching your lower back. Keep your chin slightly tucked.

latPulldown.title: Lat Pulldown
latPulldown.setup: Sit with your thighs locked under the pads and grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders. Sit tall with your chest up.
latPulldown.actionPhase: Pull the bar to your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back, then let your arms straighten under control.
latPulldown.formCheck: Keep your chest up and your shoulders down. Do not lean way back or yank the bar with momentum.

seatedCableRow.title: Cable Row
seatedCableRow.setup: Sit tall with your feet on the platform, a small bend in your knees, and your arms straight holding the handle.
seatedCableRow.actionPhase: Pull the handle to your lower ribs, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades. Let your arms straighten slowly.
seatedCableRow.formCheck: Keep your chest up on the way forward and your body mostly still on the pull. Do not round your lower back or lean way back to cheat it.

tBarRow.title: T-Bar Row
tBarRow.setup: Hinge over the bar, or lie on the chest pad, with your back flat and your arms hanging long.
tBarRow.actionPhase: Pull the weight toward your lower chest or belly with your elbows close to your sides, then lower it until your arms are straight.
tBarRow.formCheck: Keep your back angle the same the whole set. Do not yank with your lower back or shrug to finish the pull.

assistedPullUp.title: Assisted Pull-Up
assistedPullUp.setup: Kneel or stand on the assist pad, grip the handles overhead, and pick enough help that you can move smoothly. Let your shoulders settle down.
assistedPullUp.actionPhase: Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it, then lower until your arms are almost straight.
assistedPullUp.formCheck: Lead with your chest and elbows. Do not kip, swing, or shrug your shoulders up to your ears.

chestPressMachine.title: Machine Chest Press
chestPressMachine.setup: Sit with your back flat on the pad, your feet planted, and the handles at mid-chest height. Pinch your shoulder blades into the pad.
chestPressMachine.actionPhase: Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight, then bring them back until your elbows are just behind your body.
chestPressMachine.formCheck: Keep your shoulder blades on the pad and your shoulders down. Do not shrug or bounce out of the stretch.

pecDeck.title: Pec Deck
pecDeck.setup: Sit tall with your forearms on the pads, or your hands on the handles, and a small bend in your elbows. Set the seat so your arms start about level with your chest.
pecDeck.actionPhase: Bring your arms together in front of your chest, squeeze, then open slowly until you feel a stretch.
pecDeck.formCheck: Keep that soft elbow bend the whole way. Do not let your shoulders roll forward at the finish or bounce at the stretch.

cableFly.title: Cable Chest Fly
cableFly.setup: Stand between the cables with a small bend in your elbows and one foot slightly forward. Start with your arms open and your hands about shoulder height.
cableFly.actionPhase: Sweep your hands together in a wide arc until they meet in front of your chest, squeeze, then open slowly back to the start.
cableFly.formCheck: Keep your chest up and your body still. Move from your shoulders, and do not turn it into a press by bending and straightening your elbows.

shoulderPressMachine.title: Machine Shoulder Press
shoulderPressMachine.setup: Sit with your back against the pad, your feet flat, and the handles near ear height. Keep your ribs down.
shoulderPressMachine.actionPhase: Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight, then lower them until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
shoulderPressMachine.formCheck: Keep your back on the pad and your shoulders down. Do not lean back or shrug at the top.

cableFrontRaise.title: Cable Front Raise
cableFrontRaise.setup: Set the cable low and stand facing away from the stack, holding the handle in front of your thigh. Keep a small bend in your elbow and your ribs down.
cableFrontRaise.actionPhase: Raise the handle forward until your hand is about shoulder height, then lower it slowly back to your thigh.
cableFrontRaise.formCheck: Keep your body still and lift with your shoulder. Do not lean back or swing the cable to get the handle up.

cableLateralRaise.title: Cable Lateral Raise
cableLateralRaise.setup: Stand beside a low cable and hold the handle in the hand farther from the stack. Keep a small bend in that elbow and stand tall.
cableLateralRaise.actionPhase: Raise that arm out to the side until your hand is about shoulder height, then lower it slowly.
cableLateralRaise.formCheck: Lead with your elbow, not your wrist. Do not swing the cable or lean away from the stack.

facePull.title: Face Pull
facePull.setup: Set a rope at about upper-chest height, step back, and hold the rope with your arms straight. Stand tall with your core tight.
facePull.actionPhase: Pull the rope toward your face and turn your hands out so they finish beside your ears. Let your arms straighten slowly.
facePull.formCheck: Pull with your upper back and the back of your shoulders. Do not shrug or lean back to yank the rope.

tricepPushdown.title: Tricep Pushdown
tricepPushdown.setup: Stand tall at a high cable with your elbows pinned to your sides and your hands on the bar or rope.
tricepPushdown.actionPhase: Straighten your elbows until your arms are straight, squeeze, then bend them back without letting your elbows drift forward.
tricepPushdown.formCheck: Keep your upper arms still beside your ribs. Do not lean into the stack or use your shoulders to push the weight down.

cableCurl.title: Cable Biceps Curl
cableCurl.setup: Stand facing a low cable with your palms up and your elbows pinned to your sides.
cableCurl.actionPhase: Curl the handle toward your shoulders, squeeze, then lower it until your arms are almost straight.
cableCurl.formCheck: Keep your elbows still beside your ribs. Do not swing your body or let your elbows travel forward.

preacherCurl.title: Preacher Curl
preacherCurl.setup: Sit or stand so your upper arms rest flat on the preacher pad, with your arms almost straight at the bottom.
preacherCurl.actionPhase: Curl the weight toward your shoulders without lifting your elbows off the pad, then lower it slowly.
preacherCurl.formCheck: Keep your wrists straight and your shoulders relaxed. Do not bounce out of the bottom stretch.

cableCrunch.title: Cable Crunch
cableCrunch.setup: Kneel under a high cable with the rope behind your head or at your shoulders, and your hips stacked over your knees.
cableCrunch.actionPhase: Curl your ribs toward your hips, pause, then rise back up without pulling with your arms.
cableCrunch.formCheck: Move by rounding your spine, not by yanking the rope or only hinging at your hips. Keep the rope close to your head.

backExtension.title: Back Extension
backExtension.setup: Set your ankles under the pads and your hips on the pad, with your arms crossed at your chest. Start with your body in a straight line.
backExtension.actionPhase: Hinge forward with a flat back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then lift until your body is straight again.
backExtension.formCheck: Squeeze your glutes to finish and keep your neck long. Do not throw your chest up past a straight line.

cableKickback.title: Cable Glute Kickback
cableKickback.setup: Clip an ankle cuff to a low cable, face the stack, and stand on the other leg with a small hinge and a soft knee.
cableKickback.actionPhase: Drive the working heel back and up until you feel your glute squeeze, then return without slamming your foot down.
cableKickback.formCheck: Keep your hips square to the floor. Do not arch your lower back or turn your foot out just to get higher.

aroundTheWorld.title: Around the World
aroundTheWorld.setup: Stand tall holding a plate at the center of your chest, with a small bend in your elbows and your ribs down.
aroundTheWorld.actionPhase: Circle the plate around your head in a smooth path, then bring it back to your chest. Go the other way on the next rep.
aroundTheWorld.formCheck: Keep your neck long and your hips still. Move from your shoulders, not by twisting your lower back.

barbellCleanPress.title: Barbell Clean and Press
barbellCleanPress.setup: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet and your hands just outside your shoulders. Hinge down with a flat back and grip the bar.
barbellCleanPress.actionPhase: Pull the bar up close to your body and catch it on the front of your shoulders. Then press it overhead until your arms are straight, and lower it back to your shoulders.
barbellCleanPress.formCheck: Keep the bar close on the pull and your elbows up in the catch. Finish the press with your ribs down and your head through your arms.

cableChestPress.title: Cable Chest Press
cableChestPress.setup: Set two cables at chest height, face away from the stacks, and hold a handle in each hand beside your chest. Stagger your feet so you stay balanced.
cableChestPress.actionPhase: Press both hands forward until your arms are straight, then bring them back until your elbows are in line with your shoulders.
cableChestPress.formCheck: Keep your shoulders down and your wrists over your elbows. Do not lock your elbows hard or let one side drift ahead.

cableCrossover.title: Cable Crossover
cableCrossover.setup: Stand between high cables with one foot slightly forward. Hold a handle in each hand and start with your arms open and a soft bend in your elbows.
cableCrossover.actionPhase: Sweep your hands down and together in a wide arc across the front of your body, squeeze at the bottom, then return slowly to the open position.
cableCrossover.formCheck: Keep your chest up and your elbows slightly bent the whole time. Do not turn the movement into a press by straightening your arms hard at the bottom.

tricepRopePushdown.title: Tricep Rope Pushdown
tricepRopePushdown.setup: Face a high cable with a rope attachment. Grip the rope with your elbows tucked tight to your ribs and your forearms roughly parallel to the floor.
tricepRopePushdown.actionPhase: Press the rope down until your arms are straight, spread the ends slightly at the bottom, then bend your elbows to return under control.
tricepRopePushdown.formCheck: Keep your upper arms still beside your body. Do not lean over the stack or let your elbows drift forward.

reverseGripTricepPushdown.title: Reverse-Grip Tricep Pushdown
reverseGripTricepPushdown.setup: Face a high cable with a straight bar and take an underhand grip. Stand tall with your elbows pinned to your sides.
reverseGripTricepPushdown.actionPhase: Straighten your elbows to press the bar down until your arms are straight, squeeze, then bend your elbows back without letting them drift forward.
reverseGripTricepPushdown.formCheck: Keep your wrists neutral and your upper arms still. Do not use your shoulders or lean into the movement to move the weight.

seatedLowRow.title: Seated Low Row
seatedLowRow.setup: Sit tall at the low row station with your feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and your chest up. Grab the handle with your arms extended toward the stack.
seatedLowRow.actionPhase: Pull the handle toward your lower belly, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades. Return with control.
seatedLowRow.formCheck: Keep your torso still and your chest lifted. Do not lean far back or use your lower back to yank the weight.

plateLoadedRow.title: Plate-Loaded Row
plateLoadedRow.setup: Set a plate-loaded row machine to a comfortable starting weight. Sit with your chest on the pad if it has one, feet flat, and a neutral grip on the handles.
plateLoadedRow.actionPhase: Pull the handles toward your ribs, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades. Lower until your arms are almost straight.
plateLoadedRow.formCheck: Keep your shoulders down and your spine neutral. Do not shrug or let your chest lift off the pad to finish the rep.

dumbbellShrugs.title: Dumbbell Shrugs
dumbbellShrugs.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your body. Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
dumbbellShrugs.actionPhase: Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as you can, pause, then lower them slowly back to the start.
dumbbellShrugs.formCheck: Move only at your shoulder blades. Do not bend your elbows or roll your shoulders forward to make the weight move.

cableExternalRotation.title: Cable External Rotation
cableExternalRotation.setup: Set a cable at elbow height with a single handle. Stand sideways to the stack with your upper arm pinned to your side and your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
cableExternalRotation.actionPhase: Rotate your forearm away from your body, keeping your elbow at your side, then return slowly without letting your shoulder roll forward.
cableExternalRotation.formCheck: Use a light weight and move only at the shoulder. Do not lean away from the cable or swing your torso to get the handle back.
